summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release announcing that its shares trade ex-dividend on the NYSE as of August 14, 2026, for the first-quarter 2026 cash dividend of USD 0.39 per share. This is a routine capital return event, not a special-situation transaction; no board recommendation or advisors are named. The filing is a standard notice under Norwegian disclosure rules. What to watch: effective payment date and any subsequent dividend declarations; there is no risk-arb angle as this is not a merger or acquisition.
